newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ciba first half financial loss narrows.
newsitem.headline: Ciba first half financial loss narrows.

text.p: Swiss chemicals and pharmaceuticals group Ciba-Geigy AG said its financial result in the first half of the year improved by 40 million Swiss francs, narrowing the net loss to 76 million from 116 million.

Ciba said in its interim report that interest income had fallen by 57 million francs due to a sharp drop in money market rates, while investments in fixed income were kept at a low level. This avoided losses in view of weak bond markets.
Ciba also reduced the equity proportion of the balance sheet due to a historically high valuation of equity markets.
First half financial income fell to 143 million francs from 200 million.
Financial expenditure, however, was not reduced in proportion as financial debt is mainly concentrated in traditionally weaker currencies.
Financial expenditure amounted ot 238 million francs in the first half compared with 241 million.

A 26 million franc gain in currencies -- compared with a loss of 68 million last year -- was the result of a downward correction in the Swiss franc and the absence of major devaluations in emerging market countries, Ciba said.
